content.short: mesha provides an all-in-one platform for DAOs and web3 companies to manage financial operations.
content.description: mesha enables DAOs and web3 organizations to streamline and scale their financial operations. It combines expense management with corporate cards backed by crypto and supports on-chain reimbursements, helping teams track and control spending across web3 ecosystems. In addition, mesha provides accounting and bookkeeping capabilities with automated transaction tagging to simplify recordkeeping and improve financial visibility for decentralized teams.
content.meta: mesha helps DAOs and orgs manage financials with expense management and on-chain reimbursements. Discover mesha and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
